headline: Midland County Power Backup Report
summary: Homes in Midland County face a long outage about once every 16 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 28% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth went without power for about 47 hours. In May 2024, 7% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth went without power for about 16 hours. One Core lasts about 16 hours in August. One Core lasts about 35 hours in November. Two Cores last about 25 hours in August. Two Cores cover 96% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
